g.text: Video Streaming: Upload -> Transcode -> Adaptive Playback via CDN
Same video, three resolutions cached at the edge; the player picks per-segment
Adaptive playback: same viewer, same video, quality changes between segments
Manifest lists every quality/segment combination up front.
Because each segment is independently requestable, the player
can switch UP or DOWN at the next chunk boundary -- no
re-download of earlier bytes needed to change quality.
